prompt: Why must all four cups face the SAME way around?

options.text: So the wind pushes one side hard and the other weakly — the uneven push makes the spin

explanation: Open cups catch a strong push; rounded backs catch a weak one. Facing them all one way keeps the push uneven all the way round.
